__comment: Glass envelopes ONLY, split out of receiver.json so they can be drawn on a render type that does not write depth - see SoundstageRenderTypes.glass. Glass that writes depth stamps itself into the depth buffer and then hides the filament glowing inside it. Every envelope is TWO nested boxes: vanilla models are single-sided, so the inner shell is what makes the glass visible from inside.

elements.__comment: Tube 1 envelope, INNER surface - a shell 0.02 inside the outer one. A vanilla block model emits outward-facing quads only, so from inside the bottle (looking up from underneath, or through the near wall) there is simply nothing to draw and the glass vanishes. NO_CULL on the render type did not override that. A nested inner box gives the inward view its own outward-facing quads, which no render state can undo.
